metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后可持续可分配现金利润为正，但 market_cap / discounted_sustainable_net_profit 为 18.56 年，高于 profit_cheap 的 15 年门槛；折后可剥离净现金也只覆盖约 42.55% 市值，因此归入 liquidation_watch。

cash_breakdown.reason: Note 18 and financing reconciliation disclose S$0.865m due to NCI shareholders.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Construction contractor needs project liquidity for subcontractors, suppliers, manpower and working-capital timing.
cash_breakdown.reason: Conservative reserve, about 1.3 months of FY2025 cost of sales plus administrative expense; supported by large project pipeline and working-capital volatility.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cash is mainly in Singapore operating entities while the listing vehicle is offshore/HK; extraction would likely face timing, tax and remittance frictions.
cash_breakdown.reason: No exact remittance schedule disclosed; reserve is about 2.5% of group cash and deposits.

profit_quality.assessment: FY2025 reported profit is not a clean recurring denominator because it includes S$27.572m bargain purchase gain. Construction project cash flow was positive across FY2023-FY2025, but margins and working capital swing sharply by project stage. Main denominator uses a conservative S$4.0m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and a 0.55 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Excluded S$27.572m bargain purchase gain from Fishbox/Apollo Aquarium acquisition.
Excluded S$0.107m marketable securities fair value gain because the securities principal is treated as detachable cash asset.
Did not capitalise bank interest income as sustainable operating profit because cash/deposit principal is deducted in the detachable cash pool.
Treated 2025 OCF strength cautiously because trade and retention payables increased S$35.708m while contract asset/liability net movement consumed S$16.356m.
Used three-year history: parent net profit S$35.939m in 2025, -S$8.485m in 2024 and S$3.398m in 2023; OCF after capex was positive but project-cycle-driven.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Project-based contractor with one loss year in the last three years, major customer/project concentration and large working-capital swings; cash conversion exists but cannot support using FY2025 reported profit.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported OCF is positive, but 2025 cash generation relies heavily on payables expansion and project timing.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: FY2025 purchase of PPE was S$2.268m; no explicit maintenance/growth split.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Trade/retention receivables, contract assets and payables are large relative to recurring profit, so cash profit requires a material haircut.
